value.rationale: The invariant is the complete number-by-class-size profile of local S5 information cells witnessing a universally true common unary proposition. The theorem quantifies a natural simultaneous first-order random-model event, identifies its sharp logarithmic marking threshold, gives a joint total-variation law rather than merely expectation, and exposes an exact finite-size independence principle despite the shared mark. It directly informs probability of multiagent knowledge witnesses, a motivated quantity absent from single-structure Bell enumerations.
